Title: Couple of questions from our tournament.

Messages.Author: Neil Paananen
Messages.Body:
A couple of questions in games I was involved in came up in our Fort
Collins, Colorado Storyline tournament (which the Nosferatu won, by
the way).

1. Some of us thought that you couldn't play a political action card
for a vote during a blood hunt. Can you?

2. I was playing Baali (I came second!) and it was ruled that if I
jumped to my master phase (played a master) and forgot to pay for the
Infernalism then my Baali were tapped and I couldn't go back. What
would be an official ruling on this?

That's all, thanks.

Neil Paananen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Neil Paananen wrote:
> 1. Some of us thought that you couldn't play a political action card
> for a vote during a blood hunt. Can you?

Yes. See the blood hunt rules. [6.5.6]

> 2. I was playing Baali (I came second!) and it was ruled that if I
> jumped to my master phase (played a master) and forgot to pay for the
> Infernalism then my Baali were tapped and I couldn't go back. What
> would be an official ruling on this?

Penalty Guidelines section 114 - Procedural Error - Misrepresentation

Baali are tapped by the Infernal Rule only during the untap phase,
not at other times.

You (the judge) either let it stand (not likely, since this will
almost certainly represent a benefit for the player committing the
infraction), retro it (allow the player to make the choice and redo
all of the events that had occured since then) or provide "some
other game saction" to maintain the balance of the table.
